overview: The One Crore Internship Programme Karnataka is a state-level initiative launched by the Government of Karnataka to provide internship opportunities to one crore (10 million) youth across the state. The programme aims to bridge the skill gap between academic learning and industry requirements by offering hands-on training in various sectors. It targets students and recent graduates from educational institutions in Karnataka, enabling them to gain practical experience with government departments, public sector undertakings, and private industries. The initiative is designed to enhance employability and foster industry-academia collaboration.
objectives: Provide internship opportunities to one crore youth in Karnataka
Bridge the gap between academic knowledge and industry skills
Enhance employability of students and recent graduates
Offer practical training in government, public sector, and private organizations
eligibility: Students pursuing undergraduate, postgraduate, or diploma courses, as well as recent graduates from recognized educational institutions in Karnataka, are eligible to apply for the internship programme.
benefits: Participants gain hands-on work experience, industry exposure, skill development in relevant domains, networking opportunities with professionals, and a certificate of completion upon successful internship. The programme also provides a stipend to interns during the training period.
financial_support: The programme offers a monthly stipend to selected interns, the amount of which varies based on the sector, duration, and guidelines issued by the implementing agency. The stipend is disbursed directly to the intern's bank account after verification of attendance and performance.
application_process: 1. Visit the official internship portal at https://internship.karnataka.gov.in 2. Register on the portal using personal and academic details 3. Fill out the internship application form with preferred sector and location 4. Upload required documents such as identity proof, academic certificates, and resume 5. Submit the application and await confirmation 6. Attend counselling or interview if required 7. Upon selection, report to the assigned internship organisation 8. Complete the internship duration and submit feedback 9. Receive certificate of completion and stipend disbursement
required_documents: Identity proof (Aadhaar card, voter ID, or passport)
Bank account details for stipend transfer
Bonafide certificate from educational institution (if currently studying)
deadlines: Rolling basis — applications are accepted throughout the year based on availability of internship positions.
implementing_agency: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood (SDEL), Government of Karnataka
caveats: Internship positions are subject to availability and allocation by participating organisations
Stipend disbursement is contingent upon satisfactory attendance and submission of required reports
The programme does not guarantee employment after completion of the internship
Interns must adhere to the code of conduct and confidentiality norms of the host organisation
